title: Design System: OpenOrc rail and document study

display.purpose: Task and welcome-page headings use Charter with platform serif fallbacks. Thread titles use 13px semibold system type in the top toolbar.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: A flat writing surface with a fine border and tonal settings toolbar.

shadows.name: current-row
shadows.purpose: Selected navigation uses tonal fill instead of cast depth.

motion.name: search-hover
motion.purpose: Short feedback on the sidebar search control.

narrative.northStar: A calm place to think with coding agents
narrative.overview: A compact app rail and a single thread sidebar, with project selection in a popover, document conversations, a task workspace, and contextual inspector. Settings uses a horizontal category toolbar, aligned preference rows, and an account usage ledger.
keyCharacteristics: Threads and Orclings have separate rail destinations sharing one navigation sidebar
Flat persistent surfaces and a sidebar resize grip on the seam
A single-color face mark and an interactive Orcling study with sample data
Compact thread titles in one toolbar and one author line per conversation turn
A writing surface with a settings toolbar and separate Git strip
Flat responsive settings with one category toolbar
Usage limits show one primary reported amount and secondary report details

rules.name: Semantic Color
rules.body: Read live palette roles instead of hardcoding study colors into components.

rules.name: Context once
rules.body: Keep agent and project identity with the composer instead of repeating it in the conversation header.

rules.name: Text input focus
rules.body: Use a surface and caret change without an outline or halo for text inputs. Preserve visible keyboard focus on buttons, tabs, and disclosures.

rules.name: Reported allowances
rules.body: Show remaining allowance when reported, otherwise used allowance. Keep unknown and stale values explicit and preserve reset outcomes.

dos: Do preserve saved palettes and custom colors.
Do keep native window-control clearance and existing product workflows.
donts: Do not treat this study as global product identity approval.
Do not treat synthetic preview content as product facts.
